name: sod-modern-devkit
description: LLM-first diagnostics and authoring tooling for the Mount & Blade 1.011 SoD Modern module system.

interfaces.mutation_contract: read-only contract compiler front-end: canonical src fragments remain authoritative; compile and export layers are impact evidence only, and there is no apply command

typed Feature Intent planning is read-only; apply is source-only, SHA-guarded, dry-run by default, requires an exact reviewed feature-plan ID, and applies one named source target at a time; compile and export layers are never written

pack discovery, validation, compilation, preview, review, verification, snapshots, and diffs are read-only; catalog-apply may save exactly one reviewed strict devkit/content_forge/packs.json pack contract after an exact catalog-plan ID, current catalog SHA, dry-run rehearsal, and SAVE CONTENT PACK confirmation; apply selects exactly one named specialist change with an exact content-plan ID and current SHA, dry-run by default; source changes delegate to Feature Authoring, troop/item records delegate to Balance Lab with its explicit legacy acknowledgements, and generated/ID/export layers are never written
a labeled snapshot writes only a confined ignored DevKit baseline; source, compile, and export files are always read-only
apply is source-only, hash-guarded, and dry-run by default

apply delegates semantic route edits to the Change Router source-only SHA gate and is dry-run by default; deterministic route creation additionally requires an anchored JSON contract, source SHA, and exact reviewed plan ID
apply delegates semantic layout edits to the Change Router source-only SHA gate and is dry-run by default; preview writes only devkit/output SVG artifacts
semantic source authoring delegates to the Change Router source-only SHA gate and is dry-run by default; dialogue and presentation semantics remain delegated to their specialist composers

apply-move is hash-guarded and dry-run by default; source fragment moves write only one explicit src/**/_order*.txt manifest, protected engine/legacy moves require an explicit override, dialogue moves delegate to the existing same-fragment Change Router gate, and baselines/reports are confined DevKit artifacts

patch/apply operate only on direct legacy compile/module_items.py or compile/module_troops.py authoring records after build-route confirmation; apply is SHA-guarded and dry-run by default, non-dry changes require explicit legacy-authoring acknowledgement, hardwired records require an extra override, and IDs/order/generated/export layers are never written
all diagnostic and validation workflows are fixed, bounded, and source-read-only; contract baselines, reports, and disabled drafts write only DevKit artifact paths and never activate module content

optional human UI only; binds exactly 127.0.0.1, has no generic file editor/build/export action, renders the typed Content Forge player-facing preview/review workspace, may save exactly one reviewed strict devkit/content_forge/packs.json contract through its separate SHA/dry-run/SAVE CONTENT PACK gate, and delegates semantic source changes to the existing SHA-guarded specialist apply paths with dry-run default and explicit APPLY SOURCE confirmation

dialogue_apply, dialogue_create_apply, presentation_apply, module_apply, feature_apply, content_pack_apply, content_pack_catalog_apply, apply_source_edits, order_apply_move, and balance_apply are dry-run by default; semantic applies use SHA guards, deterministic dialogue creation and feature/content-pack apply additionally use exact reviewed plan-ID guards, content_pack_catalog_apply is confined to one strict devkit/content_forge/packs.json entry and additionally requires its catalog-plan ID/current catalog SHA/SAVE CONTENT PACK confirmation, feature/content-pack apply are confined to one named canonical source or direct legacy-record target at a time, balance_apply is confined to explicitly confirmed legacy item/troop authoring records, order fragment moves are confined to explicit src/**/_order*.txt manifests, and preview/baseline/draft artifacts write only confined DevKit paths
